note: On-screen text per story beat (the ids of the old voice lines L01-L35), what the viewer must read while the beat holds. tools/timeline.py turns it into reading time. kind: disp (DISPLAY), label (LABEL ≥ 40 px), cap (caption ≤ 36 px), mono, ui (a screenshot: glanced, not read). how: read, skim (half), glance (fixed), known (seen before). 'added' lists text added when the voice was dropped (2026-09-28): each line's message must be on screen. 'changed' logs text reworded later, 'dropped' text taken off screen, each with its date and reason. 'beats' pins a beat's length (tools/timeline.py never makes it shorter): the user kept the timeline when a beat's text got shorter (2026-10-04).
